text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! Whoa, everyone is so 
cute...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You're good at this kind of thing, 
huh? Normally, people can't get this 
many."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I probably couldn't have pulled that off. 
You're really good at games too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's not it. I know, just wait a 
second... um."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Where should I display it? I should ask 
Taiki— Ah, I haven't told you the most 
important part yet, have I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for winning this for me. ...I'll 
have them put it up at my parents' house, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for winning this for me. Hehe, 
I'll send one to my family's place too!
